blocks.heading: Specialised Certifications Build Credibility with Recruiters, But

items.text: Google Ads certifications (Search, Display, Measurement)
Free, directly testable in interviews, and covers the platform most performance-marketing entry roles are built around.

blocks.heading: Digital Marketing Roles Suit a Numbers-First Mind

items.text: Not every digital marketing role plays to a commerce background equally, and the order below is not arbitrary: performance marketing leads because it has the clearest route to scaling beyond one employer's pay band, since a track record there converts into freelance or agency work billing multiple clients at once.
Performance marketing / PPC executive
You manage ad spend across Google and Meta, track cost per acquisition, and adjust budgets based on what is converting.

blocks.heading: Use Four Questions for This Decision

items.text: Deciding whether digital marketing is worth building on top of your commerce degree needs more than enthusiasm.
Do you want a numbers-heavy lane (performance marketing, marketing analytics) or a creative-heavy lane (content, social, brand).
Picking the lane that matches your actual coursework preferences beats picking the one that sounds more glamorous online.

blocks.heading: Building Proof with No Agency Job Yet

items.text: Recruiters hiring for entry-level digital marketing roles see the same certificate names on every resume.

A small test campaign on your own page, a friend's small business, or a college fest event page gives you real numbers to talk about in an interview: what the budget was, what the result was, and what you would change next time.
One finished, explainable campaign or dashboard beats five completed certificate courses with nothing built on top of them.

blocks.heading: Mistakes Commerce Students Make Entering Digital Marketing

items.text: Numeric comfort is a real advantage, but recruiters still need to see it applied to an actual campaign, dashboard, or spend decision, not just claimed on a resume.
A stack of free certifications from Google, Meta, and HubSpot looks similar for every applicant.
Even performance-marketing and analytics roles need you to read and give feedback on ad creative and landing pages.
Do not try to decide your entire specialisation this week.
Start with Google Ads and GA4 certifications since they build directly on your existing numeric strength, then build one small practice campaign or dashboard within the same stretch of time.
Run the decision through the four questions above, then pass Three proofs before you commit a longer stretch of learning time to a specific lane.

visuals.heading: Commerce Background Actually Fits Digital Marketing

items.text: Digital marketing is a "soft," creative-only field, best left to mass-comm or design graduates.
A commerce degree only prepares you for accounting, CA, or an MBA, not marketing.
You need a marketing-specific degree before you can enter the field seriously.
Certifications alone are enough to get hired, without any practice work behind them.
